-    have hbase : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 := h0_moduleKSheaf C

-    have hL1 : L = 1 := eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one K hchi L hcl
-    rw [hL1, map_one]
